editorial_candidates.reason: The statement gives the same-color decomposition and then a functorial exact sequence with named inclusion, quotient, shift, and polynomial factor. A compact diagram could make the embedding of the overlap corner into the middle corner and the opposite-end quotient easier to track. Check arrows 0 → F̄_i E_i M → E_i F̄_i M → q^{-(α_i|β)} M ⊗ k[t_i] → 0 and label the functorial graded quotient; the text already states this completely, so no rendering or mathematical defect is claimed.

The example computes the rank-one cyclotomic blocks at weights 0, α_i, and ≥3α_i, and compares E_iF_i and F_iE_i on the vacuum. A small weight string with the vacuum and α_i nodes, F_i/E_i arrows, and the zero block beyond rank two could summarize the concrete commutator check. The graded dimensions and shifts are explicit in the prose; no defect is claimed.
